description: 29 illustrated creature body forms and 3 additional mature body forms, with independently generated front and rear views. The game applies species colors and subtle size/coat variations; these are not 256 independently illustrated character designs.
assetPreparation: PNG to WebP format encoding at quality 94; original transparency retained. Runtime crops individual atlas cells and normalizes transparent sprite bounds.

prompts.frontA:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production-ready transparent monster sprite atlas for the ORIGINAL Japanese browser RPG Pachi Monsters.
Create one square 2048x2048 sprite sheet with EXACTLY 16 completely separate full-body creatures in a mathematically regular 4 columns by 4 rows grid, each cell square and equal. Absolutely no grid lines, captions, numbers, letters, scenery or floor. Transparent background. Each entire silhouette fits within its cell with at least 12% empty padding on every side, feet aligned at 85% of cell height, wings and tails never cross cell boundaries.
Style: premium finely drawn HD pixel art, exquisite deliberate pixel clusters and clean dark colored contours, nuanced material shading, beautiful expressive faces, coherent anatomy, readable silhouette, appealing polished original fantasy creature design. Not crude geometric blobs. Not 3D, not vector, not blurry painterly art. Rich but harmonized jewel-and-natural palette. Small and medium creatures with mature craftsmanship. All are FRONT THREE-QUARTER battle view looking toward lower right, face and chest visible. No resemblance to any existing monster franchise.
Exact cell order left-to-right then top-to-bottom:
Row 1: (1) sprig: small ivory woodland seed spirit with upright green leaf ears, leafy collar, round soft body and four little paws; (2) rabbit: elegant mint-green hare with very long folded leaf ears and white chest, short cotton tail; (3) fox: coral-red slender fire fox with cream chest and long curved flame-tipped tail; (4) wolf: dignified dark teal forest wolf with silver mane and amber eyes, standing four-legged.
Row 2: (5) cat: graceful lavender cat with crescent-shaped ear tufts, plumy long tail, pearl chest; (6) otter: friendly turquoise river otter with smooth fur, cream belly, transparent blue droplet gem at chest, broad paddle tail; (7) bear: stout gentle moss-green bear with honey-colored chest marking and small round ears; (8) stag: noble emerald deer with branching copper antlers bearing tiny leaves, cream underside, long four legs.
Row 3: (9) goat: sky-blue mountain goat, sweeping spiral cream horns and snowy beard, nimble hooves; (10) owl: rounded pale blue and cream owl with layered cloud feathers and alert warm eyes; (11) crane: elegant turquoise crane with long neck and long legs, white wing feathers, gold beak; (12) phoenix: crimson-gold mythical bird, arched spread wings, long flowing fiery tail feathers, regal head.
Row 4: (13) gryphon: silver-teal griffin with eagle head, lion hindquarters, powerful feathered wings and curled tail; (14) lantern: original gold-and-amber lantern moth with luminous patterned broad leaflike wings, fuzzy small insect body and delicate antennae; (15) bat: charming midnight violet bat with wide scalloped wings and soft fur, two bright eyes; (16) beetle: polished amethyst rhinoceros beetle with six articulated legs and a crystalline forward horn.
One creature per cell, precisely sixteen. Use transparent alpha around every creature, including between all parts. Consistent illumination from upper left, detailed without noise.
prompts.backA:
Use case: identity-preserve
Asset type: matching rear-view sprite atlas for a Japanese original fantasy RPG.
Edit target: supplied sixteen-creature atlas. Re-render these EXACT SAME 16 characters with the same colors, proportions, distinguishing features and grid order, but turn EVERY creature around 180 degrees so we see only its BACK THREE-QUARTER VIEW, looking away toward upper left. Faces and chests must NOT be visible: show backs of heads, shoulders, wings, fur patterns and tails. The camera is behind each creature. Do not just mirror the fronts.
Keep a precise 4 columns by 4 rows grid. Entire bodies isolated on true transparent alpha. No floor, shadows, text, labels, borders or checkerboard. Give each sprite 8% transparent margin so no sprite touches neighboring cells or image edge. Premium finely detailed pixel art, delicate crisp pixels and clear silhouette. Same top-left light. No glowing colored halo outside silhouettes.
Order:
row1 woodland leaf-eared ivory seed spirit; mint leaf-eared hare; coral fire fox with flame tail; dark teal silver-maned wolf.
row2 lavender long-tailed cat; turquoise river otter with broad paddle tail; moss-green bear with leafy back; emerald leaf-antlered deer.
row3 sky-blue spiral-horned goat; blue cream owl; turquoise long-neck crane; crimson gold long-tail phoenix.
row4 teal silver griffin; amber lantern moth; violet bat; purple crystal rhinoceros beetle.
Exactly sixteen rear-facing creatures, each centered in its own equal square cell, no omissions.
